scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,web,api,worker "npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/shared" "npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/web" "npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/api" "npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/worker"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run dev -w @aegis-trials/worker
scripts.build:backend: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @aegis-trials/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build -w @aegis-trials/web -w @aegis-trials/api -w @aegis-trials/worker
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck --workspaces
